requests.title: GermanCro languages
requests.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single transparent decorative website sticker for a software project card, displayed about 70 pixels wide. Subject: Three interlocking speech bubbles shaped like a compact pinwheel, containing very simple flashcard symbols. German black/red/gold accents, Croatian red/white/blue accents, English navy/red accents. Use colour accents only, no flags with coats of arms, no letters or text. Make a sophisticated graphic silhouette, not an emoji.
Style: Crisp premium flat vector-style raster illustration. Strong clean contours, two or three solid colours, subtle warm-white die-cut edge following the subject exactly. Strictly 2D, no perspective extrusion, metallic surface, gradients or 3D lighting.
Composition: one compact self-contained silhouette centered on a square canvas, fills about 90 percent of the frame with a small transparent margin. Every shape and line must remain legible at small size. Background: genuine alpha transparency everywhere outside the cutout, including holes. No backdrop, checkerboard, paper rectangle, scene, mockup, drop shadow, watermark or unrelated ornaments. High quality refined graphic design.
